role: You are a senior graphic designer and motion designer who builds award-level animated academic presentations (Apple Keynote / Pitch / After Effects quality). You combine scientific accuracy with rich, cinematic visual design.
task: Create a 15-slide, fully animated 16:9 presentation in the Kazakh language that teaches the basics of the Python programming language through the cytology topic 'Euglena' (эвглена): data, information, building models and building histograms. Every slide must have its own entrance choreography, a smooth slide transition and subtle ambient motion. Use ONLY the Kazakh on-screen text given below, word for word.

content_rules: All visible text in Kazakh exactly as written in this prompt; Latin is allowed only for Python code, library names and the species name 'Euglena viridis'.
Fonts MUST render every Kazakh letter correctly: ә ғ қ ң ө ұ ү һ і (Cyrillic + Cyrillic-Extended). Never substitute missing glyphs with a fallback font.
Python code must be real, runnable Python 3 and must be shown exactly as given (indentation preserved, comments in Kazakh).
All numbers on charts must match the dataset below (seed = 2025, n = 120). Mark the data as 'оқу мақсатындағы модельденген деректер' (simulated for teaching).
Maximum 40 words of body text per slide; the rest is visual (diagrams, code, charts).
One key idea per slide; strong visual hierarchy: eyebrow → title → visual → short caption.

visual_elements: Hand-crafted vector euglena cell: spindle body, pellicle stripes, 10–12 green chloroplasts, red stigma (eyespot), pulsing contractile vacuole, nucleus with nucleolus, white paramylon grains, long waving flagellum.

principles: Motion explains the content: data flows, cells divide, curves draw, bars grow.
Every slide has 3 layers of motion: (1) slide transition, (2) staggered entrance of elements, (3) quiet ambient loop.
Stagger elements in reading order: eyebrow → title → visual → details → caption.
No bouncing text, no spinning titles; elegance over noise.

content.title: Эвгленаның объектілік моделі
content.code:
class Euglena:
    def __init__(self, length=52.4, energy=50):
        self.length = length      # мкм
        self.energy = energy      # шартты бірлік

    def feed(self, light: bool):  # миксотрофия
        self.energy += 10 if light else 4

    def swim(self):               # талшықпен жүзу
        self.energy -= 3

    def divide(self):             # бойлай бөліну
        if self.energy >= 80:
            self.energy /= 2
            return Euglena(self.length, self.energy)

cell = Euglena()
for hour in range(5):
    cell.feed(light=True)
    cell.swim()
print(cell.energy)                # 85
child = cell.divide()             # 42.5 + 42.5
